WITH telescope_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    o.observstation,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories o
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
avg_telescope_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(telescope_count AS FLOAT)) AS avg_count
  FROM telescope_stats
)
SELECT 
  ts.observstation,
  ts.avg_bandwidth,
  ts.telescope_count,
  CAST(ts.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / atc.avg_count AS ratio
FROM telescope_stats ts
CROSS JOIN avg_telescope_count atc
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
